sources.summary: Dezeen Showroom: from glossy to stone-effect tiles, Italian manufacturer Marazzi has listed a handful of its versatile products on Dezeen Showroom. Mystone Pietra di Sicilia tiles are made from porcelain, yet evoke the warmth and tactility of stones mined in Sicily.
